decisions.state_note: o000: window approximately x154–218, y81–145; dark fragment enters upper-left edge, with white below/right. Shape and continuation unknown.
o001: window x122–186, y81–145 shows a thick dark stroke rising right, cropped at top and bottom-left; white on both sides locally. No visible endpoint or junction; detector returned no instances.

o002: window x122–186, y49–113 shows a dark curved right edge bulging near (175,75), with a white slit extending from the left edge toward (149,75). Detector identifies a short rising-right band near (154,83); broader shape remains cropped.

o003: window approximately x90–154, y49–113 shows dark material around a narrow white region rising right from (105,100) toward (147,76); white region reaches right crop edge. Upper-left has white outside a sloping dark contour. No detector instances; closure unknown.

o004: window x90–154, y81–145 shows a broad dark diagonal region continuing through bottom edge; narrow white wedge near (105,99) opens toward top. Both ends remain cropped; detector returned no instances.

o005: window x90–154, y113–177 shows a thick dark band rising right, with white margins along both sides in its lower portion; band crosses top and bottom crop edges. Detector supports rising-right orientation near (114,147); no endpoint established.
o006: window x90–154, y145–209 shows a thick rising-right dark band crossing top and left edges, with white to its right and below. Detector agrees on orientation; no terminal cap visible.

o007: window x58–122, y145–209 shows a thick rising-right dark band, cropped at top and reaching the lower edge near x63–83. Detector supports its diagonal orientation; lower termination remains uncertain.

o008: window x58–122, y160–224 shows a diagonal dark shaft rising right and a rounded lower termination near (74,209), with white below. Detector agrees on the diagonal and rounded tip. Upper structure remains unknown.

o009: window x58–122, y128–192 shows the rising-right shaft reaching right and bottom crop edges, plus a dark rounded protrusion at the top near x83 with white beneath it. Detector identifies the diagonal shaft; relationship to upper structure remains unknown.

o010: window x58–122, y96–160 shows a rounded dark bulge near (83,119), white below-left, and dark material continuing through top/right edges. A narrow white notch enters near (96,136); no detector instances. Upper contour remains cropped.

o011: window x58–122, y64–128 shows a thick dark stroke rising right, with white to its left and a narrow white recess near (113,94) entering from the right. Detector supports diagonal orientation near (92,92); upper contour and recess closure remain cropped.

o012: window x58–122, y32–96 shows white above a thick dark stroke rising right from near (80,92) through the right edge near y50–81. Stroke is cropped below and right; no detector instances. Upper extent remains unknown.

o013: window x90–154, y32–96 shows white above a broad dark arch, nearly horizontal near (138,59), with a narrow white recess below near (141,77). Detector supports horizontal and rising-right portions; right continuation is cropped.

o014: window x122–186, y32–96 shows a dark upper arch rounding right near (175,75), with a white recess below. Detector supports horizontal and rising-right portions. Together with the earlier upper curved structure and long shaft ending near (74,209), this supports digit 9.
